in_marathi.name: Jadav
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jadav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jadav is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jada', which means 'God's Gift'. In Hindu mythology, the name is believed to be given to a child who is considered a divine gift to his parents. The name is also associated with the God Vishnu and his avatar, Rama.
